notes.title: Game Update: Drops is LIVE, Go To Market, Press R, Inventory, Icon and Counter
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to roll out our latest patch! This update brings new content, critical fixes, and some polish to make your experience even better. Let’s dive into what’s new:

New Features

Drops is LIVE: Head and Suits drop is now available on Bonki BONK, time to collect all the accesories, start collecting the items from common to Legendary, gotta catch them all! Thank you @deedzmore for the feedback on this.

Go To Market Access Added: The button to steam market is now live! Head to the settings and click "Go To Market" Button and you will be headed to steam Market Hub to browse and purchase head and suits customization, you can also access the steam market from Library > Bonki Bonk pages.

Press R to Show Disappears Bonki Bonk: If Bonki Bonk hidden while your PC sleep or in standby mode you can press "R" to bring back the game to the top of your screen.

Bug Fixes
Player Log Optimization: We’ve addressed the player.log file size issue reported by @sheep7000. The score logging system for the leaderboard has been streamlined to prevent excessive file growth, ensuring smoother performance and less storage strain.

Count %1000 Bug Fixed: Fixed an issue where the in-game counter was incorrectly calculating values modulo 1000, leading to display errors. The counter now accurately reflects your progress.

Icon Pack Refresh: We’ve updated the icon pack for common, epic, rare and legendary, UltraBONK will coming next.

New Achievement: We have added new achievement, please take a look and enjoy steam achievement.

Lifetime Counter: Lifetime click and type counter is sync with steam cloud saves so don't worry about missing the progress.

We will Keep update the game, stay tuned for more features, don't forget to leave your feedback!
